text:
In town, the tap is unlikely to run dry: cities are protected first. The real risks are cost, timing and rules. Before you buy: Who supplies water to this site? Does the project need its own water rights, and at what cost? What's the supplier's drought plan?

Watch the full breakdown on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=auormf6yM2Q

Source: 2026 Rio Grande Regional Water Plan. Narration is AI-generated. Not financial advice.
